reasons.action: No visual reference governs action; the brief explicitly asks the lighthouse keeper to climb the tower stairs and light the lamp, so the requested action owns it.
reasons.medium: No visual reference or rendering-style reference is present, so the rendering medium is request-governed rather than reference-governed.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference supplies observed clothing, so wardrobe is governed by the request; there is no reference wardrobe to override.
reasons.lighting: No visual reference supplies lighting; the storm is scene context rather than an explicit lighting instruction, so lighting remains request-governed.
reasons.framing: No visual reference supplies framing, and the brief specifies canvas aspect rather than an actual camera composition, so framing is request-governed.
reasons.palette: No visual reference supplies palette or tonal grade, so the request owns palette with no observed look to preserve.
